title: UNEP MARS brought 192 methane plumes to Turkmen officials' attention in a year; the government may have repaired at least eight significant leaks (aggregate, no single event documented)
summary: Eurasianet (3 September 2026) and The Chemical Engineer (May, Sep 2026), relaying UNEP: 192 MARS alerts to Turkmenistan in a year, about 40 answered, at least eight significant leaks repaired.
account: Eurasianet reported on 3 September 2026 on UNEP's Methane Alert and Response System (MARS) in Turkmenistan. MARS brought 192 instances of methane plumes to the attention of Turkmen officials during the last year. Turkmenistan addressed about 40 of the cases by providing details about the leaks and proposing plans to plug them. The government has repaired at least eight significant leaks. Turkmenistan had three of the six worst leaks detected over the past six months and nine of the top 50. A UN official is quoted calling this “an incredible first step”. The Chemical Engineer (5 May 2026) reported that six significant sources had stopped emitting in 2026 following MARS alerts, including three in Turkmenistan. On 4 September 2026 it reported that UNEP's August snapshot included eight examples of mitigation of sources across the country. It describes Turkmenistan as a known hotspot for emissions from aging oil and gas infrastructure. UNEP's September 2026 snapshot lists Turkmenistan sources among the top 50 emitters, for example a gas disposal facility and several flares. No cited source names a repaired site, a date, an operator or a tonnage for any single repair. The Guardian's 31 August 2026 report and The Times of Central Asia's 1 September 2026 report are known by headline only and are not among the sources.
purpose: Satellite-based detection and notification of large methane plumes so that governments and operators mitigate them. The reported repairs are that purpose.
system: UNEP IMEO Methane Alert and Response System (MARS): satellite plume detection and analysis with AI models, notification and satellite confirmation
deployer: UNEP International Methane Emissions Observatory (notification); Government of Turkmenistan and its oil and gas operators (repairs; entities not named in cited sources)
domain: Climate change mitigation / methane emissions monitoring
segment: Oil and gas sector; intergovernmental observatory

ratings.reason: No named operator or dated repair.

ai_role.statement: News reports relaying UNEP credit the repairs to MARS alerts. The AI contribution is described only in UNEP's general statement that IMEO analyzes satellite data with advanced AI models. No per-site evidence, no government or operator statement and no UNEP case document for Turkmenistan are among the sources. The AI role cannot be isolated for any specific repair.
